records.evidence_sentence:  Low Probability of Heatwave conditions likely during some days of week 2 over Rajasthan, Gujarat, Vidarbha, Madhya Pradesh and Uttar Pradesh. Appreciably above normal (+3.1 to +5.0°C) maximum temperatures are likely over parts of Rajasthan & adjoining Madhya Pradesh, Gujarat; above normal (+1.6 to +3.0°C) temperatures are likely along the northwest, central & adjoining eastern parts of the country. Near-normal maximum temperatures are likely across rest of the country during the week.
